== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The original targets a character or vehicle at the same or an adjacent site and downloads an eligible Effect. The remaster targets a character, denies opposing landspeed during your turn and adds +1 to your Force drains at the captive’s site. The eligible Boba Fett and capture threshold remain.
